name: Local Network Access
description: Lets other devices on your network open BossMod in a web browser with an access code you choose. The connection isn’t encrypted, so turn this on only on a network you trust.
summary: Open BossMod from other devices on your network.
author: JTechMinds LLC

settings.label: Network access
settings.help: Other devices use this port and access code to open BossMod.

fields.label: Port
fields.hint: Change it only if another program already uses this port.

fields.label: Access code
fields.hint: At least 6 characters. Capital letters don’t matter. Changing it signs every device out.
